metadata.title: Conformal geodesics and the hyperboloid at timelike infinity
metadata.abstract: A description of scattering in asymptotically flat spacetimes that includes both radiation and massive asymptotic states requires control of the relation between null and timelike infinity. Motivated by this problem, we use the properties of conformal geodesics to construct an extended representation of timelike infinity in Minkowski spacetime. The construction exploits the fact that every non-null metric geodesic in an Einstein spacetime is, up to an explicit local reparametrisation, a conformal geodesic. It replaces the point $i^+$ by a hyperboloidal boundary $\mathcal{H}^+$ meeting future null infinity $\mathscr{I}^+$ at a corner $\mathcal{C}^{+}$, while fixing the location of $\mathscr{I}^+$ in the associated conformal Gaussian gauge. In this gauge, we derive the equations governing massless scalar and spin-$2$ fields. In particular, we obtain a transport equation for the scalar field along future null infinity and analyse the asymptotic behaviour of its spherical-harmonic modes near timelike infinity. We also derive the explicit massless spin-$2$ equations in this gauge. Finally, we examine the relation to projective extensions and to the hyperbolic base of the extended Carrollian space $\mathrm{Ti}$. Our results provide a geometric framework for studying the connection between late-time and null asymptotics which is a prerequisite for scattering constructions relevant to flat space holography.

analysis.workSummary: 以共形测地线和共形 Gaussian 规范，将 Minkowski 时空的类时无穷远点扩展为与类光无穷远相交的双曲面边界。
techniques: 共形测地线与重参数化
球谐模态与无质量场方程
analysis.breakthrough: 在同一规范中推导标量场输运与 spin-2 方程，连接晚时渐近和类光渐近的几何描述。
analysis.limitations: 核心构造在 Minkowski 背景完成；一般 Einstein 时空中的测地线重参数化性质不等于已建立所有渐近平直时空的散射理论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
